acceptance: `evolve loop --preflight-only` runs the pre-batch checks and dispatches no cycle (red: flag provided but not defined)
A failing blocking check exits 1 naming it; all passing exits 0
No run lease or cycle-state file is written
fix: Add `--preflight-only` to `evolve loop`. It parses the arguments as a launch would, runs the same pre-batch gate (honouring --skip-preflight-boot), prints each check's verdict and exits without dispatching. Exit 0 when every check passes; exit 1 naming the blocking check that failed. It writes no run lease and no cycle state. Document it in runtime-reference.md's boundary step 4 as the check before launch.
source: console, 2026-09-30, core-function CLI inventory (operator request: a CLI request for each core function)
summary: internal/looppreflight runs its checks (CLI health, versions, routing warnings, base divergence, the bridge-boot probe) only inside `evolve loop` (cmd_loop_preflight.go). `evolve loop --dry-run` prints the resolved config without running them (cmd_loop_args.go:45), and `preflight-environment` and `doctor boot|live` each cover only part of the gate. The only full readiness check is therefore a real launch, and a failing check is found with the batch already started.
title: The loop's pre-flight readiness gate runs only at launch; add `evolve loop --preflight-only` to check readiness without starting a batch
